title: Nice way to store toys and other items around your house
text: Nice way to store toys and other items around your house. Great, nice-sized (13.75x13.75x17) storage. I am using it in my home to hold my grandchildren's toys when they aren't visiting. It is well made, fairly light and easy to carry around when you need to move it from one place to another. If there is any downside at all (which is why I deducted a star) is that if you don't have it close to full it kind of crunches collapses in. I would have preferred a sturdier unit that could still collapse but have more support when open.

description: Woven paper textured storage bins are a fun and creative way to organize and store toys, clothes, blankets, towels, books, knick-knacks and more. Tired of clutter in the kids room, living room, or laundry room? These storage containers are the perfect solution to organize the clutter while enhancing your home’s décor. Get creative with fun designs and colors that are easy to mix and match. Add some sparkle with metallic or bring color and interest to a dull room with vibrant hues and a sophisticated look while also adding functionality. These trendy bins have become very popular due to their simple yet chic look, versatility, and dependability. Sturdily constructed, these storage bins are up to the task of being carried to-and-fro, used to transport groceries, laundry, or household goods. DII storage bins are made from high quality woven paper with thick, yet soft cotton rope handles for easy transport. These rope handles are designed to give you optimal tension and comfort while transporting. When not in use, simply collapse the sides and store bin flat. The material and construction provides a long lasting bin that you can use over and over again.
